title: Onboard Mirage-13b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, changelog automation
author: Ananya Gupta
description: Adds Mirage-13b v1.0 to the model registry with metadata, model card, and performance profiles across GPU/CPU/quantized variants; wires the model into changelog/release-notes automation so new model versions appear in release feeds. Motivation: Mirage is an open 13B variant we validated for Redwood inference workloads and customers requested a Redwood-verified profile and release notes. Changes include model metadata JSON, performance profiles for T4/A100/H100 and INT8/FP16 variants, example workloads used for profiling, an integration test to smoke the onboarding flow, and an update to the changelog automation that picks up model-registry additions. Checklist: [x] model card and metadata added; [x] perf profiles added (GPU/CPU/quantized); [x] integration tests added; [x] changelog automation updated (+ unit tests); [x] docs updated with model entry. Related: ENG-8421 (model onboarding), PM-311 (product acceptance). See commits and changed files for details.

review_comments: Priya Shah (reviewer): Please include latency/throughput numbers for the INT8 path and clarify which quantization toolchain was used (bitsandbytes vs. custom script). Also tighten the fallback profile for <1ms p50 targets on small batches.

Ananya Gupta (author): Updated perf profiles to include INT8 numbers and note in metadata that bitsandbytes v0.40 was used for offline quantization. Tightened fallback thresholds in t4_int8.yaml per suggestion.

Marco Diaz (reviewer): The changelog automation change looks good but can you add a unit test to validate that the template renders when a new model metadata.json is added? CI perf suite flaked once; please ensure rerun is stable.

Ananya Gupta (author): Added unit test test_changelog_model_entry and moved the collector tests to run before changelog publish. I re-ran perf-suite and fixed a flaky fixture related to sample workload seeding.
Linus Carter (approver): Verified perf numbers and sanity-checked the model card. Approving pending CI green.
release_notes: Added Mirage-13b v1.0 to model registry with verified performance profiles for A100, H100, and T4 including INT8/FP16 variants; automated changelog/templates updated to surface model onboarding entries; integration tests and docs added for Mirage-13b.
notes_for_ops: Perf profiles include conservative default batch/seq settings; operators should review autoscaling tickets for Dedicated pools if customers enable Mirage at scale. See perf-profiles/README for tuning guidance.
testing_summary: Integration test ensures registry ingestion, changelog unit test validates template rendering, perf-suite run captured A100/H100/T4 results. No production regressions observed in canary stage.
